import os
from cyhole import Helius

def list_das_assets(wallet_address: str):
    """List all DAS assets owned by a wallet address using Helius."""
    api_key = os.getenv("HELIUS_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable not set")
    
    helius = Helius(api_key)
    
    assets = helius.das.get_assets_by_owner(owner=wallet_address)
    return assets

if __name__ == "__main__":
    wallet = "YOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS"
    result = list_das_assets(wallet)
    print(result)

import os
from cyhole import Helius

def list_das_assets(wallet_address: str):
    """List all DAS assets owned by a wallet address using Helius."""
    api_key = os.getenv("HELIUS_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable not set")
    
    helius = Helius(api_key)
    
    assets = helius.das.get_assets_by_owner(owner=wallet_address)
    return assets

if __name__ == "__main__":
    wallet = "YOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS"
    result = list_das_assets(wallet)
    print(result)
